notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1
notes.content: [h2]Changelog Patch 0.1[/h2][p][/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]When you go to map scene, camera follow mode is now set as default camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can choose to set playable window borderless yes/no.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the game use the hardware cursor mode for more perfomance.[/p][/*][*][p]Every day/night cycle now  a notification reminds you how many days remains to quest expiration.[/p][/*][*][p]Totally rebalancing of equipments and bonus/malus calculation. A New Game start it is advisable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed overlay bug when King sends new fresh troops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, for some reason, missions would not expire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of translation strings.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Devlog #8 - New Battles Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Power indicator of two armies.
[*] When you have to deploy troops, a small icon will immediately let you know which weapon he is equipped with, and whether it is a Ranged or a Melee.
[*] ability to speed up combat with x2 or x3.
[*] GUI improvements.
[*] obstacles caused by boulders that cause the troops that have to avoid them to get stuck and slow down.
[*] zoom out at the end of the battle
[/list]

From today, you'll find the Steam page and the game available in the following languages:
[list]
[*] Italian
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] German
[/list]
